_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves, this is a textbook coil where HOLD is the statistically honest default — no breaker is visible on either side, and forcing direction here is precisely how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing no breaker; narrative implies UP reversal is imminent. Split is real but analyst's base-rate evidence carries more weight.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed rises to 35+ with stablecoin_growth >55 and funding <40 (Anxiety resolving upward), OR ETF flows >30 with funding dropping below 35
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX >75 with BTC momentum_30d flipping negative (Panic cracking toward Capitulation), OR ETF flows stay at 0 for 2+ weeks with BTC momentum_30d below 45
